title: Objectives of a Good Plant Layout
prompt: State four objectives of a good plant layout.
hint: Mention eliminating bottlenecks, minimizing worker movement, improving safety, and increasing productivity.
sample: Eliminate bottlenecks, minimize worker movement, improve safety, increase productivity.
